name: Pomodoro
description: A focus session like Windows Focus: pick the total minutes, optionally split into 22-33 min focus blocks with 5 min breaks, then follow the ring. Pause, skip, add 5 minutes, a toast at each phase change and a daily tally of focus minutes. Survives restarts.
author: AmineChr54
changelog: Focus sessions: set the total minutes, breaks off by default or 22-33 min blocks with 5 min breaks, ring with ticks, pause and a ... menu (skip, +5 min, end), toasts at phase changes. The focus/break minute options are gone; the daily log is kept.

autoStart.label: Start the next phase automatically
autoStart.hint: Off: the session waits for you at each break and focus period.

notify.label: Notify at each phase change
notify.hint: Also switch on Allow notifications for this widget in Settings.
